what:
Non-blocking follow-ups to #14241 (Alpaca re-arm preflight), from the manager's APPROVE re-review of 2c047b6 (2026-09-29 17:32Z). Fix in one small follow-up PR after #14241 lands.
(1) _alpaca_top_up_uncovered: a confirmed-breach exit that returns 'deferred' still sets the 900 s top-up cooldown although nothing was posted. The sweep comment near the exit_deferred counter (which says the next sweep's top-up rests a stop) is therefore wrong.
(2) An escalated stop (after _BREACH_DEFER_MAX unconfirmed deferrals) that the venue REJECTS is never recorded, so the re-arm cap never advances and the stop is re-posted every sweep. Check whether Alpaca rejects a sell stop priced above the market.
(3) After escalation, the breach-channel page text ('NOTHING is resting') and the 're-arm refused (breach_deferral_escalated)' label are wrong, because the stop has been posted.
(4) Verify which exit_reason the reconciler records when an escalated stop fills on arrival.
(5) _ALPACA_BREACH_DEFERRALS is never pruned for closed rows; prune it as _prune_rearm_attempts does.
